title.af: Aanskou: Ons word wat ons aanskou
title.en: Beholding: Becoming What We Gaze Upon

summary.af: Ons word wat ons aanskou. God roep mense met harte van klip om na Hom te kyk, en wys Homself aan ons in Jesus, die volmaakte beeld van die Vader. Terwyl ons aanhou kyk, verander die Heilige Gees ons na sy beeld, en bou Hy ons saam in as lewende stene in een muur wat sy lig weerkaats.
summary.en: We become what we behold. God calls hard-hearted people to look at Him, and shows Himself to us in Jesus, the perfect image of the Father. As we keep looking, the Holy Spirit changes us into His likeness and builds us together as living stones into one wall that reflects His light.
